messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock down scouting criteria, incentive tiers, onboarding timebox, and success metrics for the next partner cohort. Draft brief + invite here: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-beta-brief — please comment by EOD Fri. TL;DR proposal: 12 partners, 4-week core beta, 2-week onboarding window, $250 credit + early feature access.

Miguel (Eng): 4-week core sounds better than 6. Less timeboxed is harder to measure. Also we should list the telemetry we require (p50/p95 latency, token cost per session, error rate).

Priya (DevEx): Agree on 4-week core. Suggested recruitment segments: AI-native startups (Series A/B, 1–3 ML engs), mid-market product teams (SaaS feature owners), and infra/platform teams for integration tests. Track adoption: API calls/week, unique users, and a simple task completion flow.

Tom (CS): From experience, incentives that convert: waive first-month fee + $300 credits or $200 + swag. Also require a named product contact and a 1-pager use-case to qualify. That avoids tire-kickers.

Lina (Research): Proposed success metrics: 1) Integration success (API up >80% of beta) 2) Quality regression <=5% vs their baseline across 3 eval prompts 3) Activation (first realistic query within 7 days) >=40% 4) Retention at 2w >=60%. Weekly survey (3 questions) + 1x end-of-beta interview.

Aisha (PM): Good, Lina — can you draft the 3 eval prompts and the weekly survey? Miguel, can you list the minimal telemetry we need for the onboarding checklist?

Miguel (Eng): Will do. Minimal telemetry (for checklist):
```
- p50_latency_ms
- p95_latency_ms
- requests_per_minute
- token_cost_per_min
- 5xx_error_rate
- kv_cache_hit_rate
```
I'll add the instrumentation snippet to the onboarding doc.

Priya (DevEx): I'll own onboarding materials + a short SDK quickstart (5–7min). Also recommend a 30m kickoff call within their onboarding window. Signup form fields I propose:
```
- company_name
- primary_contact_name
- email
- slack_workspace (optional)
- use_case_brief (200 words max)
- expected_monthly_qps
```
I'll make this a short Typeform and share link.

Tom (CS): I'll take case-study follow-ups and schedule end-of-beta interviews. I'll also prepare a one-page checklist for legal/security asks so Private customers can fast-track.

Evan (deploy-bot): created board: https://boards.redwood.internal/beta-cohort-2026 - column: scouting -> outreach.

Aisha (PM): Ownership recap: Miguel + Priya = outreach & signup form; Priya = onboarding docs & SDK quickstart; Lina = eval prompts + weekly survey; Tom = case studies + security checklist. Can someone own outreach email copy and cadence?

Miguel (Eng): I'll draft initial outreach copy and the signup form flow. Will ping for edits.

Priya (DevEx): I'll own the onboarding call template + 15m checklist call for early adopters.

Aisha (PM): Quick decisions needed: 1) Incentive: $300 credit + waive onboarding fee OR $200 + swag? 2) Final cohort size: 10 vs 12? Please react with :thumbsup: (opt A) / :thumbsdown: (opt B) and add comments. Also propose weekly 30m sync during the 4-week core.

Tom (CS): I prefer $300 + waived fee and cohort of 10 (more focus). :thumbsup:

Lina (Research): +1 to $300, cohort 10 makes sense for qualitative depth.

Miguel (Eng): +1 on $300, but ok with 12 if we have 2 dedicated onboarding slots.

Priya (DevEx): Lean 10 as well. I'll prepare materials assuming 10, can scale to 12 if needed.

Aisha (PM): Great. I'll update the doc and publish outreach template by Tues. Thanks — please add any final constraints on the doc before EOD Fri.

Priya (DevEx): Quick note — for recruitment prioritization, prioritize customers with an immediate deployment path (VPC or Dedicated interest) so we can validate routing/rollout policies.

Aisha (PM): Good call. Adding that to screening criteria now.

Miguel (Eng): One last technical ask: add a fallback model policy in the onboarding checklist so partners know what happens if capacity is constrained. I'll draft the fallback matrix.

Aisha (PM): Perfect. Closing loop — doc will be live: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-beta-brief (updated). We'll reconvene next Tue if there are major blockers. Thanks all :rocket:
